title: 第14章 逆天修炼速度

content_zh:
叶心夏心终于平静了下来。
“心夏，那些家伙已经被我收拾掉了，以后他们不会再来找你麻烦。”莫凡把轮椅放在了叶心夏的面前。
“我刚才看到了……看到了雷，好像是雷系初阶技能雷印。”叶心夏说道。
莫凡一听，整个人都得意了起来，但却是笑而不语，只是用那双坏坏的眼睛盯着叶心夏。
叶心夏感觉不太对劲，仔细想了想，漂亮的眸子里闪过一丝诧异。
“释放雷印的人是莫凡哥哥？？”
莫凡也不承认，就是那样笑着。
“真的是你，莫凡哥哥是魔法师了？？”叶心夏有些不敢相信的道。
“哈哈，你算是第一个见到我真正力量的人！”莫凡一个任性，非常突然的在叶心夏那白嫩嫩的可爱脸颊上吧唧了一口。
叶心夏哪里料到会被这样偷袭，脸颊一下子粉红粉红的，甚至粉到了脖颈。
莫凡这才意识到自己有些太得意忘形了，急忙解释道：“对不起，对不起，我太激动了。”
叶心夏声音如蚊：“那……那你真的已经是一位魔法师了？”
莫凡点了点头。
“我们老师说雷系觉醒一千个人中只有一位。在初阶，雷系的优势非常大，堪称初阶元素系之首。”叶心夏此时也为莫凡高兴。
家里的状况叶心夏也是知道的，更何况自己成为了他们的家人后凭白无故的又给莫家兴叔叔增添了不少负担，听姑姑说，莫家兴叔叔已经把房子给卖掉了，想来确实是家庭窘迫到了一定程度。
她和莫凡都还小，想为莫家兴叔叔分忧也很难，能做的就是好好学习，成为一个真正的魔法师才可以缓解现在这个家庭的危机。
看来，还是莫凡哥哥厉害，竟然这么短的时间就学会了魔法……
咦，不对呀！
忽然，叶心夏意识到了什么，那双漂亮得会说话的眼睛那样看着莫凡。
莫凡一本正经的道：“怎么了？”

“你觉醒半年不到，据我所知再有天赋的人，他们也需要接近一年时间才能够完成初阶技能的释放。”叶心夏说道。
莫凡愣了一愣。
不会吧，天赋高的人从觉醒到释放也需要一年的时间？？
那……那自己半年不到就完成了初阶的运用，这速度貌似确实太快了！
问题是，这事莫凡压根不知道啊。
在他看来穆白那蠢货都已经可以掌握4颗、5颗星子了，自己能够释放魔法不很正常吗？
可为什么叶心夏一脸很不敢置信的样子，更有一种看怪物的味道？
难道，半年不到学会初阶技能在这个世界里真的灰常变态？？
“你刚才所谓的‘再有天赋也要一年’的‘再有天赋’指的是什么层次的？”莫凡小心翼翼的问道。
莫凡可不想暴露自己对这个世界其实还有很多无知。
“穆宁雪算是我们博城最有天赋的了，比得过帝都很多天才级学生，但她从觉醒到学会冰系初阶技能也用了8个月的时间。”叶心夏说道。
“8……8个月吗？”莫凡听得有些傻眼了。
穆宁雪何等人物？
整个博城唯一一个直接被帝都学府录取的，本身又是穆世家所有人的掌上明珠，从小受到整个穆氏浓厚魔法底蕴的熏陶，拥有平民魔法师这一辈子都不可能获得的修炼资源。
而她之所以会被众星捧月，和她那惊人的魔法天赋也是息息相关的！
连她这样的天之骄女也用了8个月的时间才从觉醒到初阶魔法的释放，那自己这个只用了5个月的呢？？？
我了个草！！
我了个草啊！！
莫凡感觉内心在剧烈的翻腾了！
如果穆宁雪8个月已经惊世骇俗，被人们称之为天纵英才，那自己这5个月的岂不是得逆天啊！！

“莫凡哥哥，你……你是不是学了一些不好的……我从一位老学者那里听说，有这种修行速度的人，只可能是黑教廷。”叶心夏很小很小声的说道。
黑教廷的某些魔法邪术是可以让魔法师修炼速度大幅度提升的，叶心夏实在想不到有什么可以促使一个人在短短5个月内完成初阶魔法，尽管叶心夏知道自己的莫凡哥哥一直都聪明过人……
“黑教廷？怎么可能……是，是这样的……哦，对，我其实不是在开学典礼那天觉醒的，我在更早的时候认识了一位老头，他跟我说，小伙子，我看你根骨奇佳、天资过人，不如和我学魔法吧，我当时就问，你谁啊大叔，他告诉我他是东都魔法协会的成员，可以先帮我觉醒……总而言之，我其实不是5个月就学会的。”莫凡反应神速的解释道。

content_en:
Ye Xinxiaxin finally calmed down.
"Xinxia, ​​I have dealt with those guys. They will not come to trouble you again." Mo Fan placed the wheelchair in front of Ye Xinxia.
"I just saw...I saw thunder. It seemed to be the primary skill of thunder, Thunder Seal." Ye Xinxia said.
When Mo Fan heard this, he felt proud, but he smiled and said nothing, just staring at Ye Xinxia with his evil eyes.
Ye Xinxia felt something was not right. After thinking about it carefully, a trace of surprise flashed in her beautiful eyes.
"The person who released the thunder seal is brother Mo Fan??"
Mo Fan didn't admit it and just smiled like that.
"It's really you. Brother Mo Fan is a magician??" Ye Xinxia said in disbelief.
"Haha, you are the first person to see my true power!" Mo Fan gave a willful and sudden kiss on Ye Xinxia's lovely white cheek.
Ye Xinxia never expected to be attacked by such a sneak attack. Her cheeks turned pink all of a sudden, even reaching her neck.
Mo Fan then realized that he was a little too complacent and hurriedly explained: "I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm too excited."
Ye Xinxia's voice was like a mosquito: "Then...then are you really a magician?"
Mo Fan nodded.
"Our teacher said that only one in a thousand people awakens to the thunder element. At the elementary level, the advantage of the thunder element is very great, and it can be called the first among the elementary elements." Ye Xinxia was also happy for Mo Fan at this time.
Ye Xinxia also knew about the situation at home, not to mention that after becoming their family member, she put a lot of burden on Uncle Mo Jiaxing for no reason. Her aunt said that Uncle Mo Jiaxing had sold the house. It seems that the family was indeed in a certain degree of embarrassment.
She and Mo Fan are both still young, and it's hard to worry about Uncle Mo Jiaxing. All she can do is study hard and become a real magician to alleviate the current crisis in the family.
It seems that Brother Mo Fan is the most powerful one, he actually learned magic in such a short time...
Hey, that’s not right!
Suddenly, Ye Xinxia realized something, looking at Mo Fan with those beautiful eyes that could speak.
Mo Fan said seriously: "What's wrong?"
"It has been less than half a year since you awakened. As far as I know, no matter how talented people are, it will take them close to a year to complete the release of the basic skills." Ye Xinxia said.
Mo Fan was stunned for a moment.
No, it also takes a year for people with high talents to awaken and be released? ?
Then... Then I completed the basic application in less than half a year. This speed seems to be too fast!
The problem is, Mo Fan doesn’t know about this at all.
In his opinion, that idiot Mu Bai can already master 4 or 5 stars. Isn't it normal for him to be able to release magic?
But why does Ye Xinxia look so disbelieving that she looks like a monster?
Could it be that learning basic skills in less than half a year is really abnormal in this world? ?
"What level do you mean by 'no matter how talented you are, it will take another year'?" Mo Fan asked cautiously.
Mo Fan doesn't want to reveal that he still has a lot of ignorance about this world.
"Mun Ningxue is the most talented person in our Bo City. She is better than many genius-level students in the Imperial City. However, it took her 8 months from awakening to learning the basic ice skills." Ye Xinxia said.
"8...8 months?" Mo Fan was a little dumbfounded.
What kind of person is Mu Ningxue?
He is the only person in the entire Bo City who has been directly admitted to the Imperial Academy, and he is the apple of everyone’s eye in the Mu family. He has been influenced by the entire Mu family’s rich magical heritage since childhood, and has training resources that ordinary magicians are unlikely to obtain in their lifetime.
And the reason why she is praised by the stars is also closely related to her amazing magic talent!
Even a proud girl like her took 8 months to go from awakening to the first level.The release of magic, what about the one that only took me 5 months? ? ?
I'm confused! !
I'm confused! !
Mo Fan felt his heart churning violently!
If Mu Ningxue has already astonished the world in 8 months and is called a genius, then wouldn’t it be true that she has done so in the past 5 months? !
"Brother Mo Fan, you...have you learned something bad...I heard from an old scholar that people with this kind of cultivation speed can only be from the Black Church." Ye Xinxia said in a very low voice.
Certain magic spells of the Black Vatican can greatly increase the speed of magicians' practice. Ye Xinxia really can't think of anything that can prompt a person to complete basic magic in just 5 months, even though Ye Xinxia knows that her brother Mo Fan has always been extremely smart...
"Black Vatican? How is it possible... Yes, it's like this... Oh, yes, I actually didn't awaken on the day of the opening ceremony. I met an old man earlier. He told me, young man, I think you have great bones and extraordinary talent, so why not learn magic with me? I asked at that time, who are you, uncle? He told me that he was a member of the Dongdu Magic Association and could help me awaken first... In short, I didn't learn it in 5 months." Mo Fan explained quickly.
